market_note: nflverse games.csv spread_line / total_line / moneylines: documented only as near-close sportsbook consensus, no quote timestamp. spread_line > 0 = home favoured by that many points (home covers when margin > spread_line, i.e. home at -spread_line).

official_labels.not_joined_note: events with no dataset game within one day (e.g. preseason games, which the dataset excludes)

official_vs_score_derived.note: the official result is the label; disagreements are listed for settlement review, not corrected

official_labels.benchmark_note: closing_line_benchmark = normal distribution centred on the sportsbook closing line (sigma from earlier seasons): a DERIVED probability, not a Kalshi quote. No contemporaneous Kalshi price is in the vault snapshot, so no price, CLV or fee-inclusive result is computed.
